notes: Direct fetch worked with no WAF/blocking; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (site self-identifies as Shopline platform). Denby is a British pottery/tableware brand - the catalogue is dominated by dinnerware/glassware/drinkware and has no Lighting or Mirrors nav at all (genuine absence, not a missed extraction - Rule 0 found nothing to gain here since no room-organised or product-type lighting/mirror branches exist on this site). Counts verified via each collection's own rendered 'N items' header text, cross-checked against the page's 'Showing X out of Y products' pagination string (both numbers matched on every row = cheap exhaustion proof). Hierarchy: 'Dinnerware Sets', 'Bowls', 'Plates', 'Drinkware', 'Glassware' and 'Serveware' are curated rollup/landing collections whose population is (approximately) the union of their more specific sibling collections - per the de-dup rule (same pattern as Perigold 'All Mirrors' vs 'Wall Mirrors') these are emitted as parent grouping rows (qty null) with the specific sub-collections as the counted leaves, not double-counted. 'Table Accessories' rollup (11) = Coasters (3, in scope) + Placemats (8, EXCLUDED - titled 'Woven Placemat' i.e. fabric/textile table linen); only Coasters is emitted as its sole in-scope leaf. 'Serveware' rollup (98) contains an undifferentiated 'Trays' product type (Medium/Small Oval Tray items) with no dedicated collection URL of its own - this is a coverage gap (not extractable as a distinct leaf) noted here for transparency; Ramekins/Serving Platters/Sugar Bowls are its extractable named children. EXCLUDED and verified by reading actual product titles: 'Home Fragrance' plus its Candle Tins / Ceramic Candle Pots / Ceramic Diffusers children (all scented wax/diffuser products, e.g. 'Kiln Blue Ceramic Candle', 'Quartz Rose Ceramic Diffuser' - Home Fragrance exclusion). 'Bathroom Accessories' (16 items) dropped whole-node as a mixed rollup of bathroom hardware (Soap Dish, Soap Dispenser, Beaker) and Home Fragrance items (Candle Tin, Ceramic Diffuser) with no decorative-only sub-split available. 'Crystal Glass Sets' (9) is a leadless-crystal MATERIAL facet re-cut fully contained within the main Glassware rollup (same product titles, e.g. 'Aurora Leadless Crystal Wine Glass' appears in both) - dropped as a facet re-cut, not a distinct type. 'Denby Glassware' (33 items, handle collections/denby-glassware-1) is a near-duplicate of the main 'Glassware' collection (34 items, same product names e.g. 'Universal Large Tumblers', 'Classic Blue Wine Glass') - dropped as duplicate-at-same-level, documented here per Rule 0.6. All ~45 'Range/Pattern' collections in the mega-menu (Arc Blue, Arc Grey, Arc White, Azure(+Haze/Coast/Rimmed), Blue Haze, Carve, China By Denby, Classic White, Constance, Danha, Cotton White, Dark Grey Speckle, Dove Grey, Elements(+Sorbet Pink), Greenwich, Greenhouse, Grain, Halo(+Speckle), Heritage(+Atrium/Orchard/Pavilion/Veranda/Piazza/Terrace), Imperial Blue, James Martin Everyday/Cook, Jasmine, Kiln(+Green/Coral/Accents/Blue/Pastels + 'by Denby' variants), Linen, Modern Deco, Modus Topaz Blue, Natural Canvas, Prestige Vases, Regency Green, Studio Blue(+Accent), Studio Grey(+Accent), Statements, Stars, Teal Speckle, White Speckle, White By Denby, Sky Blue, Porcelain, Impression) were spot-checked (Halo = 83 items spanning dinner plates, bowls, mugs, vases, oven dish, pet bowl, candle pot) and confirmed to be a pattern/colourway facet cutting across the already-counted type categories, not a distinct product type - excluded per the facet/material re-cut rule. EXCLUDED per standard rules: all cookware/bakeware/pan/cutlery/kitchen-utensil/oven-dish collections (Cast Iron, Bakeware, Stainless Steel/Cast Aluminium/Anodised Pans, Pan Sets, Cooking & Baking, Oven Dishes, Kitchen Accessories, Kitchen Utensils, Cutlery Sets); all Gift-occasion collections (Christmas/Diwali/Birthday/Anniversary/Wedding/Thank You/Good Luck/New Home/New Pet/New Baby/Self/Foodie/Home Stylist/Tea and Coffee Lover/Gardener/Drink Connoisseur/Pet Owner Gifts, Gifting, Gifts Under $25/$200, Mother's Day Gifts); all Christmas/seasonal collections (Christmas Hosting/Dinner Sets/Glassware/Offers/Cooking/Decorations, Festive Essentials, Black Friday variants, Early Black Friday Offers); all Sale/marketing/navigation collections (Bestsellers, New In, Offers, Seasonal Clearance, Final Clearance/Discontinued, Flash Sale, Under $10, All Remaining Inventory, Just Arrived); Pet Bowls (pet product, out of Home Decor scope).
